capabilities: Translate double-clicked words or selected passages in PDFs via a configured model endpoint
Show translations in a popover with copy, retry and expandable source text
Fetch model IDs from the endpoint and configure target language from 16 presets or custom
Switch between automatic, click-to-translate and hotkey translation modes
Cache recent translations and cancel superseded requests
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.7+); mobile unsupported. Scanned PDFs need OCR done outside the plugin. API keys stored on disk are saved in plain text; tested on Windows only.
intentEvidence: Works with Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer and alongside PDF++.
problem: Obsidian's PDF reading has no built-in way to translate selected text, so readers of foreign-language PDFs must copy text into outside tools.

relations.evidence: Works with Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer and alongside PDF++.

summary: Translation helper that translates words and passages selected in PDFs using a user-configured OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint.
